gloss: to blend in; to dissolve into; to assimilate

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {溶|と}け{込|こ}みませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {溶|と}け{込|こ}んでいなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {溶|と}け{込|こ}んでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to dissolve into; to melt into
definitions.explanation: To become absorbed into a liquid or substance, losing its original form.

definitions.gloss: to blend in; to assimilate; to fit in
definitions.explanation: To become an integrated part of a group or environment, adapting to the surroundings.

examples.japanese: {砂糖|さとう}が{水|みず}に{溶|と}け{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: The sugar dissolved into the water.

examples.japanese: {塩|しお}がスープに{完全|かんぜん}に{溶|と}け{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: The salt completely dissolved into the soup.

examples.japanese: {夕日|ゆうひ}の{光|ひかり}が{空|そら}の{色|いろ}に{溶|と}け{込|こ}んでいった。
examples.english: The light of the sunset melted into the colors of the sky.

examples.japanese: {新入社員|しんにゅうしゃいん}は{早|はや}く{職場|しょくば}に{溶|と}け{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: The new employee quickly blended into the workplace.

examples.japanese: {地域社会|ちいきしゃかい}に{溶|と}け{込|こ}むには{時間|じかん}がかかる。
examples.english: It takes time to assimilate into the local community.

examples.japanese: {転校|てんこう}したばかりだが、もう{新|あたら}しいクラスに{溶|と}け{込|こ}んでいる。
examples.english: I just transferred, but I've already blended into the new class.

notes:
・{溶|と}け{込|こ}む → {溶|と}け{込|こ}まない (negative)
・{溶|と}け{込|こ}む → {溶|と}け{込|こ}んで (te-form)
・{溶|と}け{込|こ}む → {溶|と}け{込|こ}んだ (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {溶|と}ける (to dissolve/melt) + {込|こ}む (into)

The ～{込|こ}む pattern emphasizes becoming deeply integrated or absorbed.

COLLOCATIONS:
・{社会|しゃかい}に{溶|と}け{込|こ}む - to blend into society
・{風景|ふうけい}に{溶|と}け{込|こ}む - to blend into the scenery
・チームに{溶|と}け{込|こ}む - to fit into the team
・{自然|しぜん}に{溶|と}け{込|こ}む - to blend naturally

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{馴染|なじ}む - to become familiar with, to fit in (more about becoming accustomed)
・{適応|てきおう}する - to adapt (more formal, biological/psychological)
